name: moneymind-ai
description: MoneyMind AI — an AI-powered personal finance workspace.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @moneymind/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c green,cyan,magenta "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @moneymind/shared && npm run build -w @moneymind/api && npm run build -w @moneymind/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @moneymind/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @moneymind/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build -w @moneymind/shared && npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present
